messages:
Lena Zhou: FYI EdgeHW reported customers seeing double usage for the 2025-04-05 window after they enabled new exporter. Can we triage?
Ethan Moore: Do we have sample payloads?
EdgeHW-bot: New exporter v3 sent both per-minute files and an end-of-day aggregated rollup without rollup_id.
Priya Rao: Our ingest accepts rollups if rollup_id present; without it we try to attribute by window. That can overlap with per-minute ingestion.
Marcus Lee: marketplace-bot shows a spike in credits at 03:10 UTC when we accepted the rollup, while minute-level events were already applied at 00:05-02:55.
marketplace-bot: webhook: accepted rollup from edgehw at 2025-04-06T03:10:42Z.
Lena Zhou: Ops action: pause auto-ingest of EdgeHW rollups until they add rollup_id and source_batch_ids.
EdgeHW-bot: Acknowledged. We'll stop rollups immediately and produce a revocation file with source_event_ids. ETA 2025-04-06T18:00Z.
Ethan Moore: Short-term engineering: add rule that if hourly/minute events exist for same window and rollup has no rollup_id -> mark as "suspect" and require manual commit. Marcus can you prepare ledger diff?
Marcus Lee: running quick diff. Initial numbers: 410 duplicate-credit rows across 128 accounts, total duplicated tokens ~321,450.
Priya Rao: Good candidate for automated reversal if revocation contains exact source_event_ids. Otherwise manual reconciliation.
Lena Zhou: Billing Ops please hold any outbound credit notifications to customers in affected accounts.
Billing Ops: Holding notifications for 128 accounts.
Ethan Moore: I'll add a webhook-contract test to simulate per-minute + no-rollup rollup + retry. Priya can own the integration test.
Priya Rao: I'll extend partner-onboarding checks to require rollup_id and source_batch_ids; also add a warning if exporter reports local_date without timezone.
EdgeHW-bot: Revocation file uploaded: s3://edgehw-revokes/2025-04-06/revokes-2025-04-05.json. Signed link shared with eng@redwood.
Marcus Lee: Applied revokes in staging diff: 410 duplicates reversed, 0 remaining. Schedule for prod reversal at 2025-04-06T22:00Z pending Ops go-ahead.
Lena Zhou: Proceed with prod reversal. After reversal, ask EdgeHW to run a dry-run of their exporter and attach rollup_id in each rollup.
EdgeHW-bot: Will enforce rollup_id and include source_batch_ids starting next release. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Lena Zhou: Closing interim ops. Follow-up: update partner contract spec to require rollup_id and exporter_timezone header.
Ethan Moore: Will open PR for contract spec + add integration test.
Priya Rao: End of thread.
